Give students a question they can try while reading your notes. They might
complete a calculation, compare equivalent expressions, or move points on a
diagram. These examples show ways to make that practice part of the lesson.

Choose a page below. Try an answer and select **Check**; if you need help,
**Feedback** can suggest a next step. Open **Show source** beneath an activity
when you want to adapt it for your students.

::: {.callout-tip title="Trying the exercises"}
Use `x^2` for a power, `2*x` for multiplication and `sqrt(2)` for a square root.
**Input help** explains more. For graphical tasks, follow the instructions to
move points or draw a curve before checking your answer.
:::
